title: Oswald Peraza 2023 Topps Chrome #132 New York Yankees Rookie RC
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: The product is a 2023 Topps Chrome trading card featuring Oswald Peraza, a rookie player for the New York Yankees in Major League Baseball. Made of card stock with a chrome finish, this English-language card is part of the base set for the 2023 season and manufactured by Topps in the United States. Despite not being autographed, this standard-sized card is a valuable collectible for fans and collectors of baseball trading cards.
